name: Xxtechec Co., Ltd.
summary: Xxtechec Co., Ltd. is an e-commerce enterprise based in Taipei City, Taiwan, established in 2012. The company manages various digital marketplaces within the Taiwanese market, notably operating under the brand names Life Market, Pinecone Shopping, and Collection of Good Things in Life. Its business activities are organized into distinct segments: Non-Store Online Retailing, Online Trading Platform Operations, and additional services. Through these platforms, Xxtechec offers a diverse array of products for online purchase, including everyday essentials, consumer electronics (3C products), fresh produce, recreational items, and general groceries.
